blocks.text: As used in this Agreement, the following terms shall have the meanings set forth below:

blocks.heading: Acquisition
blocks.text: "Acquisition" by any Person means the acquisition by such Person, in a single transaction or in a series of related transactions, of all or substantially all of the assets of, or of a business unit or division of, another Person or at least a majority of the securities having ordinary voting power for the election of directors, managing general partners or the equivalent of another Person, in each case whether or not involving a merger or consolidation with such other Person and whether for cash, property, services, assumption of Indebtedness, securities or otherwise.

blocks.heading: Additional Commitment Lender
blocks.text: "Additional Commitment Lender" has the meaning specified in Section 2.15.

blocks.heading: Administrative Agent
blocks.text: "Administrative Agent" means Bank of America in its capacity as administrative agent under any of the Loan Documents, or any successor administrative agent.

blocks.heading: Administrative Agent Fee Letter
blocks.text: "Administrative Agent Fee Letter" means the letter agreement, dated October 5, 2022 among the Company, the Administrative Agent and BAS.

blocks.heading: Administrative Agent's Office
blocks.text: "Administrative Agent's Office" means, with respect to any currency, the Administrative Agent's address and, as appropriate, account as set forth on Schedule 11.02 with respect to such currency or such other address or account with respect to such currency as the Administrative Agent may from time to time notify the Company and the Lenders.

blocks.heading: Administrative Questionnaire
blocks.text: "Administrative Questionnaire" means an Administrative Questionnaire substantially in the form of Exhibit F or any other form approved by the Administrative Agent.
